input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-v8 in the Lab, as V = Qe * tau from the CO2 curve.

steps.why: Reduced speed (floor 30 percent, never stopped): moves the equilibrium to G/(0.3*Qe) and lets the curve depart from the start value of 1900 ppm.
Full speed, Qe = 1 m3/min: record the decay towards its equilibrium; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau), V = Qe*tau.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
FE-1 out of the band 45-120 bpm, monitoring lost, or one more person in the Lab

monitoring.reason: FE-1 is the only occupant of the Lab, the volume whose CO2 the test raises; the Hab-B crew are in another volume behind a closed hatch.

expected.conditions: Hatch-1-v8 closed in both steps; FE-1 alone in the Lab, awake, source about 0.38 L/min (0.26-0.45); Hab-B holds 3 people, unchanged during the test. Start from 1900 ppm.
expected.first_guess: V about 30 m3 (default, to be measured), Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed, so tau at full speed about 30 min; at 30 percent, Qe = 0.3 m3/min, tau about 100 min. Scrubber lag 3.33 min shows at each speed change.
expected.step1: With about 12.7 ppm/min generation in 30 m3 and removal 0.01*C ppm/min, equilibrium at 30 percent is near 1270 ppm, below the 1900 start; so the curve may drift slowly, not rise. The peak stays under 3000 ppm. A sustained rise above 3000 ppm would show the source or an exchange with Hab-B is larger than assumed.
expected.step2: Decay towards about 380 ppm (G/Qe) at full speed; fitted tau near 30 min if V is 30 m3. V = Qe*tau; V outside 10-200 m3 or a fit residual that is not white would show the one-zone hypothesis does not hold.
expected.hab_b_record: Hab-B CO2 recorded in both steps; a Hab-B CO2 that follows the Lab's shows the closed hatch exchanges air, which would bias V upward.
expected.invalid_if: a person enters or leaves the Lab, or any opening changes position: the curve is discarded.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone.

The exchange through the closed hatch-1-v8 is not measured and not assumed zero (design inter-module ventilation with hatch closed: 3 m3/min per station-topology); the Hab-B CO2 is recorded to bound it.
FE-1's CO2 generation is steady at the awake rate 0.38 L/min (0.26-0.45) during the whole test.
Effective flow Qe is 1 m3/min at full speed and scales with speed, with lag 3.33 min (datasheet); the decay is fitted after the lag.
The phases are shorter than one time constant (maxMinutes 60 bound) so tau is extrapolated from partial curves; the estimate is weaker than a full-tau test.
CO2 sensor co2-1-v8 is representative of the zone; records at one-minute interval together with the speed commands and whether the device accepted them.
